title:
AITI (Amendment) Order, 2003 (S13/2003) – Accounts of Authority under the Third Schedule 
                                    
                                        An Amendment to the Third Schedule of the AITI Order pertaining to a repeal of paragraphs 3 and 4 and substitution of a new paragraph 3 regarding the accounts of the Authority.
text:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE
No. S 13
CONSTITUTION OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
(Order under section 83(3))
AUTHORITY FOR INFO-COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY
INDUSTRY OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2003
In exercise of the power conferred by subsection (3) of section 83 of the
Constitution of Brunei Darussalam, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan
hereby makes the following Order
Citation.
1. This Order may be cited as the Authority for Info-communications
Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam (Amendment) Order, 2003.
Amendment of Third Schedule to S 39/01.
2. The Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei
Darussalam Order, 2001 i~ amended, in the Third Schedule, by repealing
paragraphs 3 and 4 and by substituting the following new paragraph therefor -
"3. The accounts of the Authority shall be audited annually by
(a} the Auditor General; or
(b) any person who has been authorised to perform the duties
required by the Companies Act (Chapter 39) to be performed by an
auditor, who sh-h.ll be appointed annually by the Minister in consultation
with the Auditor General:
Provided that where the accounts of the Authority have been audited by
a person appointed under paragraph (b), they may be verified by the Auditor
General before a copy thereof is submitted to the Minister pursuant to
paragraph 13.".
Made this 21st. day of Muharam, 1424 Hijriah corresponding to the 24th.
day of March, 2003 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei
Darussalam.
HIS MAJESTY
THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
